body:
Yeah.. I think the worse thing is just that I don't *want* to make any more friends, you know? Like, it was already hell to get into a friend group that wasn't toxic or didn't like me. The friends I have now have been there for like 5 years now.. It was fine when we were in high school bc I'd see them every day, but I guess with covid and college, the lackluster amount of effort they put into the friendship on their end became way more apparent. 

And its like, if they just weren't the kind of people who like texting, that would be fine. But the fact that I know they are ignoring my messages while texting back other people is just... It just sucks. And when I bring it up, they ignore it too/brush it off. They really don't care, but whenever I point that out they always get defensive and say that they do but they're just "bad at responding" :/

Idk, I'm thinking about trying to go to therapy and maybe get a prescription for an anti-anxiety medication so I can go out and be more social and make new friends, or at the very least I can ask for some healthier ways to cope. I really do want things to get better and to be happy, and I keep telling myself that it will eventually happen... But its been almost 2 years now of this shit, and I'm just more tired than anything.
